method: Manual field-by-field correspondence review of frozen enforcement.sql, frozen/catalog.sql, inspector.SESSION, retained PG17 headers and raw validator before independent replays. No SQL, resolver or product changes.
raw_discard_boundary: validate_raw(raw) executes before deepcopy, group sorting, OID deletion, or internal trigger name/definition deletion. Direct raw tests distinguish raw acceptance from selected comparison.

constraints.identity: nonempty UTF8 formatted qualified constraint identity
constraints.parent_identity: null or nonempty resolved identity; null exactly for zero parent OID

triggers.name: nonempty UTF8 NameData payload <=63 bytes checked before possible discard
triggers.event_timing_bits: nonnegative int16, only defined bits, events required, exclusive timing, no row TRUNCATE or statement INSTEAD
triggers.constraint_identity: null exactly for zero constraint OID; internal requires resolved constraint
triggers.referenced_relation: null exactly for zero referenced relation OID
triggers.constraint_index: null exactly for zero index OID
triggers.parent_identity: null exactly for zero parent OID, otherwise exact {relation:nonempty text,name:identifier <=63 bytes}
triggers.argument_hex: even lowercase bytea hex; NUL count and trailing terminator agree with argument_count
triggers.columns: empty or canonical space-separated positive int16 attribute numbers
triggers.when: null or nonempty UTF8 deparsed expression
triggers.definition: nonempty UTF8 checked before possible internal-trigger discard

parameter_acl.acl: null or nonempty UTF8 ACL text
parameter_acl.entries: null or exact object array grantor:text,grantee:text,privilege:SET|ALTER SYSTEM,grantable:bool; preserve multiplicity

parameter_effective.subject: nonempty UTF8 subject text
parameter_effective.context: null or nonempty context; null exactly when unregistered
parameter_effective.selected_set: bool; true exactly for unregistered or superuser/superuser-backend context

parameter_public.context: null or nonempty context; null exactly when unregistered
parameter_public.selected_set: bool; true exactly for unregistered or superuser/superuser-backend context

role_config.config: null or string array of nonempty name=value; empty values valid; preserve duplicates

startup_defaults.database: SQL zero emits wildcard *, positive resolves actual database name; candidate falsely rejects positive actual * name (ACSR01)
startup_defaults.role: SQL zero emits wildcard *, positive resolves actual role name; candidate falsely rejects positive actual * name (ACSR01 reproduced with actual DDL)
startup_defaults.config: null or string array of nonempty name=value; empty values valid; preserve duplicates

legacy.roles: nullable exact name plus seven bool objects
legacy.memberships: exact role/member plus admin/inherit/set bool objects
legacy.tables: nullable exact name/owner/RLS/force/ACL plus nullable columns/constraints/indexes/triggers
legacy.types: nullable exact name/owner/ACL plus nullable name/type field objects
legacy.runtime_capabilities: exact four bool fields plus reachable identifier array

primitive_rules: Exact required keys at every object; duplicate transport JSON keys reject before object construction.
Python exact bool and int types prevent bool/int equality confusion; OIDs are 1..4294967295 or optional 0..4294967295; all row OIDs unique within each group.
Text is valid nonempty UTF8 without NUL except explicitly nullable or empty-capable fields; raw identifier bounds use UTF8 bytes, not code points.
Every list element and duplicate semantic entry survives normalization. Exact selected comparison rejects unselected rows/multiplicity.

Resolved identity association validation is presence-based. Cross-row numeric OID equality is intentionally not required by the portable model contract; retained semantic identities still compare exactly.
Header/SQL domains do not select a new baseline. Registered contexts, settings, ACLs, definitions, semantic enums and retained values must still equal the separately selected manifest.
finding: ACSR01: false rejection of legal quoted asterisk role or database name in startup_defaults. Actual role case captured in attempt-1/extra-runtime/003.json.gz. No malformed selected admission or selected-safe regression demonstrated.
scope: Point-in-time prerequisite only. No concurrent privileged DDL protection, startup integration, product runtime/driver, provider, native or GA acceptance.
